title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Solid Brass | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Need more bathroom storage without giving up counter space? This wall-mounted glass shelf adds organized, easy-to-reach storage while the integrated towel bar keeps towels ready at the sink or shower.

Highlights:
- Keep toiletries and decor securely in place with a solid brass gallery rail.
- Get dependable strength and safety from 3/8-Inch thick tempered glass.
- Hang and dry towels neatly with the built-in towel bar—ideal for guest baths and daily routines.
- Maintain a clean, finished look with concealed screw mounting hardware.
- Coordinate your space with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Specs & Installation:
- Overall size: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W; projection: 5 Inches; height: 12 Inches
- Shelf glass thickness: 0.38 Inches (3/8-Inch)
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Material: Brass (hardware)
- Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw installation; no assembly required
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size: #8 x 1 1/4")
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
